notes.id: Catat investasimu: saham, reksa dana, emas, dan obligasi. Nilai dan untung atau ruginya ada di Dompet › Investasi, dan ikut dihitung di Total aset.
notes.en: Track your investments: stocks, mutual funds, gold, and bonds. Their value and gain or loss are in Wallets › Investments, and count toward Total assets.

notes.id: Plus: hubungkan Google Sheet, dan harga saham serta emas terisi otomatis. Harga reksa dana dan obligasi tetap kamu isi sendiri.
notes.en: Plus: connect a Google Sheet and stock and gold prices fill in automatically. You still enter mutual fund and bond prices yourself.

notes.id: Riwayat kekayaan: lihat Total aset di tiap periode beserta apa yang mengubahnya. Gratis melihat 6 periode terakhir, Plus melihat seluruhnya.
notes.en: Wealth history: see Total assets at the end of each period and what changed them. Free shows the last 6 periods, Plus shows everything.
